description: This PHP source file is part of a web-based network configuration interface, specifically for managing local IP configuration settings including IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, DHCP parameters, and related network settings. It includes embedded JavaScript for client-side validation and dynamic UI behavior, and server-side PHP code for fetching current network configurations.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Fetches configuration values from the device or system using a key and parameters.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves system or device string values based on a specified key path.

methods.name: getInstanceIds
methods.description: Returns instance IDs for a specific device configuration path.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a system command (like ifconfig) and returns the output lines.
